open_items: API role enum is admin | security | viewer. `ciso` and `developer` are new role claims and need backend support.
/api/me/* endpoints are proposed (docs/api/me-endpoints.yml, x-status: proposed); they are not in the v2.1 or v2.2 specs.
CISO evidence redaction is assumed to follow x-viewer-redaction. Confirm whether the CISO should see full evidence.

OWASP Agentic ids are null for CARD-PAN, PII-NRIC, SWIFT-MSG, SECRET-IN-PROMPT, PROHIBITED-SERVICE and UNDISCLOSED-ACTION. Note: DetectionFamily.owasp is `type: string` (not nullable) in v2.1, so these rows fail the schema until the spec allows null.
Framework mapping (MAS TRM, MAS Notice on Cyber Hygiene, PDPA, PCI DSS v4.0) is shown at framework level only — mapping to be confirmed with the bank's compliance team.
Whether Security should also be able to approve MCPs in a real bank rollout (maker-checker). In this tenant Admin and CISO approve; Security triages and recommends.
Brief listed CARD-PAN as 6 hits (6 blocked / 0 recorded / 1 escalated), which sums to 7. Each detection has one disposition, so the tenant uses 5 blocked + 1 escalated = 6. Confirm.

The v2.2 BridgeMcp.status enum has no 'awaiting decision' state. confluence is `scanning` with findings.scan_complete = true (an invented field) while it waits for Admin/CISO; the console shows it as 'Awaiting approval'.
Settings writes (sensors, directory, console users) and demo reset have no API operation; they are proposed as demo-only operations in docs/api/me-endpoints.yml.

Approvals (inbox) are proposed endpoints: /api/inbox and /api/workflows (docs/api/me-endpoints.yml). Decided with the product owner (30 Sep 2026): Admin and CISO publish their own drafts without a second approver; people without a permission send the change for approval.
The v2.2 BridgeMcp.status enum has no 'suspended'. Suspend is status blocked + suspended: true (invented field) so Reinstate can restore the group policy; the console shows it as 'Suspended'.

Time-limited MCP access per group is a proposed extension (decideBridgeMcp access_ttl_minutes / access_expires_at, setGroupMcpPolicy expires, McpPolicy.expires). Default in the console: 30 days. Expiry runs on real time, while the demo calendar stays frozen at 28 Sep, so the UI shows relative times ('expires in 7 days').
CISO can now deboard (removeBridgeMcp) as well as suspend: reducing access needs no second approver. Confirm this matches the bank's operating model.
